review_basis.finding_scope: Specification-level risks and falsifiers only; no implementation or receiving-host evidence reviewed yet.
review_basis.authority_interpretation: The launch is authorized within the packet's stated bounds. This review does not spend GPU resources or independently admit a recipe.

risk_falsifier_table.topic: Official primary split identity and membership
risk_falsifier_table.risk: A row-level, random, seq_ix-derived, or otherwise altered split could leak across the binding official boundary.
risk_falsifier_table.falsifier: Receiving-side manifest hash differs from 0c4de3a253d23b3a5d5ca73b7aeb7fcae2b974673e4f9ec51e94e593c59d114c, or counts/whole-sequence membership differ from 10,325 train and 1,873 valid.
risk_falsifier_table.smallest_resolution: Verify exact source files, manifest hash, whole-sequence membership and disjointness on the receiving host before fitting.

risk_falsifier_table.topic: Primary-valid exclusion
risk_falsifier_table.risk: Primary valid could enter HPO objectives, blend weights, normalizers, teacher/initializer choice, preprocessing, or early stopping.
risk_falsifier_table.falsifier: Any fit, optimizer, learned transform, candidate ranking, or adaptive decision depends on primary-valid targets or scores before finalist recipes and checkpoints are frozen.
risk_falsifier_table.smallest_resolution: Trace data flow and selection code; freeze candidates, endpoints and weights before the actual full-valid scoring pass. Keep valid diagnostics out of Optuna feedback.

risk_falsifier_table.topic: Train-only inner control/OOF and ancestry
risk_falsifier_table.risk: Inner-held-out sequences or connected components could appear in their own model's normalizer, teacher, initializer, or prediction-producing ancestor.
risk_falsifier_table.falsifier: For any inner OOF prediction, its held-out members intersect the fitting membership of any predictor or fitted preprocessing/teacher/initializer in that prediction's ancestry, or known connected groups cross the holdout boundary.
risk_falsifier_table.smallest_resolution: Require per-member ancestry/membership manifests; rebuild only the necessary inner-safe ancestors. Existing full-train TL3 remains a primary reference and is ineligible as an inner OOF member until rebuilt.

risk_falsifier_table.topic: No invented auxiliary chronology
risk_falsifier_table.risk: Shuffled seq_ix, Parquet order, or arbitrary folds could be described as chronological evidence.
risk_falsifier_table.falsifier: An auxiliary split claims temporal order without source-qualified timestamp/order metadata and a frozen manifest.
risk_falsifier_table.smallest_resolution: Use a clearly named fitting-only grouped control/OOF design without chronology claims, or provide actual temporal-order evidence before calling it chronological.

risk_falsifier_table.topic: Inner proxy is not official WP
risk_falsifier_table.risk: The all-after-warmup, weighted-Pearson train proxy could be reported or optimized as if it were official is_scored WMSE/WP.
risk_falsifier_table.falsifier: Code or reports call the inner proxy the official metric, omit its mask/selected-row count, or use train proxy loss as primary-valid-equivalent evidence.
risk_falsifier_table.smallest_resolution: Label it fitting-only proxy, persist exact row mask/count, targets and reduction, and keep official full-valid scoring separate.

risk_falsifier_table.topic: Loss/reduction/mask arithmetic
risk_falsifier_table.risk: The implementation may silently differ in target weights, Pearson reduction, masks, denominators, clipping order, or auxiliary terms.
risk_falsifier_table.falsifier: A separately derived tiny-example result disagrees with the implementation, or source trace shows a different formula/mask/reduction from the frozen recipe and declared adaptation.
risk_falsifier_table.smallest_resolution: Inspect the exact runtime path and final commands; verify formulas independently on a tiny constructed example and report any intentional adaptation as a distinct arm.
risk_falsifier_table.spec_evidence: Research-recipe-audit procedure; CONTRACT.json objective and precision declarations.
risk_falsifier_table.status: Not assessed before this initial record.

risk_falsifier_table.topic: Legacy TL3 control eligibility
risk_falsifier_table.risk: The existing full-train TL3 result/checkpoint could be reused as a train-only inner control or ensemble component despite fitting on inner-held-out members.
risk_falsifier_table.falsifier: Any inner-fit selection, OOF weight search, teacher pool or distillation target uses predictions from the existing full-train TL3 model.
risk_falsifier_table.smallest_resolution: Keep that model only as a named primary reference until the necessary inner-safe ancestry has been rebuilt and qualified.

risk_falsifier_table.topic: Qualified ensemble inputs and pooled metric
risk_falsifier_table.risk: Weights could be optimized on non-OOF/in-sample predictions, or component WP values could be averaged instead of evaluating the pooled clipped predictions.
risk_falsifier_table.falsifier: Any selected component prediction is not qualified inner OOF/control for its row, weights violate nonnegative sum-to-one constraints, or reported ensemble objective is not recomputed on pooled clipped predictions with declared metric semantics.
risk_falsifier_table.smallest_resolution: Bind each prediction row to its held-out ancestry and compute the objective from the actual weighted pooled outputs, applying clipping and target/reduction rules in the declared order.

risk_falsifier_table.topic: Checkpoint endpoint eligibility and identity
risk_falsifier_table.risk: Primary-valid best-observed moments, ambiguous scheduled endpoints, or mutable resume state could silently become finalists or ancestors.
risk_falsifier_table.falsifier: Checkpoint role/epoch/update/SHA is missing or changed, optimizer/scheduler/RNG state is not bound where resume is intended, or a primary-valid-best checkpoint enters an ancestor or frozen recipe.
risk_falsifier_table.smallest_resolution: Record scheduled, inner-selected and primary-valid-best roles separately; freeze eligible endpoints before valid evaluation and bind checkpoint/config/parent identities.

risk_falsifier_table.topic: Strict FP32 execution
risk_falsifier_table.risk: Autocast, TF32, BF16/BF16x9, or inherited process settings could change the declared scientific recipe.
risk_falsifier_table.falsifier: Runtime flags, environment, cuBLAS behavior or observed tensor/parameter dtypes show an undeclared reduced-precision path.
risk_falsifier_table.smallest_resolution: Capture receiver runtime settings and exercise the exact real-shape path; hold any changed precision as a separately identified arm.
risk_falsifier_table.spec_evidence: CONTRACT.json precision; standing project precision amendment is not declared for this new comparison.

risk_falsifier_table.topic: Shared B300 allocation and worker ownership
risk_falsifier_table.risk: Profiles or workers could alter NIER/MPS state, exceed shared-node headroom, or terminate a process not owned by this packet.
risk_falsifier_table.falsifier: Before/after process, MPS or device inventory changes outside packet-owned PIDs; a cleanup target lacks a captured packet ownership record; or initial workers exceed the measured coexistence allocation.
risk_falsifier_table.smallest_resolution: Capture read-only baseline inventory; begin at no more than one owned worker per GPU; tag and persist owned PID/process-group identities; adapt only those workers. Never stop/reconfigure foreign NIER/MPS processes.

risk_falsifier_table.topic: Six-hour and 48-attempt caps
risk_falsifier_table.risk: Ancillary OOF/TL3 ancestors or finalist refits might be omitted from the attempt count, or late work might consume the 20-minute collection reserve.
risk_falsifier_table.falsifier: Attempt ledger omits any scientific fit including auxiliary ancestors/final refits, any individual attempt exceeds 7,200 seconds, total exceeds 48, or new work continues inside the final 1,200-second collection reserve.
risk_falsifier_table.smallest_resolution: Start a monotonic deadline at first GPU profile; pre-register/count every scientific fit; stop admissions by deadline minus 1,200 seconds and collect artifacts/checkpoints/graphs.

risk_falsifier_table.topic: Stage graphs and evidence capture
risk_falsifier_table.risk: The required per-stage scientific evidence could be lost, mismasked, or reconstructed after workers are released.
risk_falsifier_table.falsifier: Any fitted stage lacks producer-native metrics, source/config/parent/checkpoint identity, required metric/mask labels, stage plots, or terminal artifact collection before owned worker release.
risk_falsifier_table.smallest_resolution: Require live events and standalone PNG/SVG exports from actual recorded metrics; retain raw metrics and checkpoint hashes before cleanup.

risk_falsifier_table.topic: Final evidence and transfer claim
risk_falsifier_table.risk: A development-exposed full-valid delta or inner proxy could be translated into an unsupported hidden/public score claim.
risk_falsifier_table.falsifier: A report predicts public/private gain from local delta alone, treats the verification tier as hidden-transfer evidence, or omits repeated validation exposure.
risk_falsifier_table.smallest_resolution: Report actual frozen full-valid evidence and its exposure; state that it does not establish hidden/public transfer or independence.

risk_falsifier_table.topic: Avoid unnecessary family-wide blocking
risk_falsifier_table.risk: A late or unimplemented adapter could unnecessarily idle already-qualified controls and consume the bounded GPU window.
risk_falsifier_table.falsifier: Runnable, independently admitted control recipes are held solely because a different optional family remains under implementation, despite separate worker/resource caps and compatible monitoring.
risk_falsifier_table.smallest_resolution: Admit ready controls and useful fallback arms independently once their own data, recipe, runtime, profile, and worker checks pass; do not let that waive any per-arm gate.
risk_falsifier_table.spec_evidence: Task-level direction to permit ready controls while late adapters are implemented; AGENTS.md rolling executable-queue policy.

risk_falsifier_table.topic: Existing inner splitter cannot create OOF from official-train-only fitting membership
risk_falsifier_table.risk: Reusing the canonical sequence_inner_splits helper for adaptive inner control/OOF assumes a nonempty fitting-valid partition that the chronological primary manifest intentionally does not contain.
risk_falsifier_table.falsifier: The manifest loaded by load_chronological_split has fit.valid=[] and CampaignSplit.valid_groups=(); _selected_membership reads only split.valid_groups and raises when fewer than two fitting validation components exist.
risk_falsifier_table.smallest_resolution: Implement a distinct train-only, whole-connected-component auxiliary OOF/control manifest and validator, explicitly nonchronological absent timestamp/order evidence; preserve heldout exclusion across every model/preprocessor/teacher/initializer ancestor. Keep the existing helper unchanged for its original contract.
risk_falsifier_table.status: Confirmed against current tracked source; new builder implementation not yet available.

risk_falsifier_table.topic: Receiving graph/index source coverage mismatch
risk_falsifier_table.risk: The old B300 graph has one fewer node than the expected combined primary train/valid sequence inventory, so cached connected components, inner membership, and any apparent OOF row coverage cannot be trusted without regeneration.
risk_falsifier_table.falsifier: Root-reported old graph count is 12479, while expected source count is 10607+1873=12480.
risk_falsifier_table.smallest_resolution: Before any fit, independently verify the regenerated graph, train/valid indexes, source audit, source hashes and split manifest against the exact receiving raw parquet files; require complete unique coverage and declared 10325/1873 fit/evaluation counts.
risk_falsifier_table.spec_evidence: Root receiving-host inventory communicated 2026-10-31; CONTRACT.json primary source hash/count policy; ADR0044.
risk_falsifier_table.status: Receiving-side discrepancy reported by root; regenerated identities not reviewed by critic.

risk_falsifier_table.topic: Campaign reserve deadline must be checked at the locked reservation boundary
risk_falsifier_table.risk: A profile/fit can pass a deadline check, block on the shared budget ledger lock, and then start after its admitted wall would cross the 20-minute collection-reserve cutoff.
risk_falsifier_table.falsifier: Current reserve_profile samples now/deadline before acquiring budget.lock; reserve_fit computes remaining wall before acquiring that lock.
risk_falsifier_table.smallest_resolution: Under the budget lock, re-read the durable deadline, recompute current time and allowable wall, then append the reserved attempt; repeat the cutoff check immediately before spawning the bounded child.
risk_falsifier_table.spec_evidence: src/wnn/multistage_search_runtime.py::reserve_profile and ::reserve_fit, reviewed after builder code became available; CONTRACT.json six-hour deadline and 1200-second reserve.
risk_falsifier_table.status: Confirmed in current builder code; corrective patch requested, not yet re-reviewed.

risk_falsifier_table.topic: Profile/fit timeout must bound actual child and cleanup wall
risk_falsifier_table.risk: Requested timeout may not be a hard wall limit if timer starts after spawn/receipt work, polling overshoots by two seconds, and termination receives an additional grace interval.
risk_falsifier_table.falsifier: Current run_owned_command starts the monotonic timer after Popen and initial receipt publication; it polls every two seconds and can wait ten seconds after SIGTERM.
risk_falsifier_table.smallest_resolution: Use one absolute deadline established before spawn, check it during supervision, and ensure termination/receipt finalization cannot push actual process wall past the per-attempt or campaign collection cutoff.
risk_falsifier_table.spec_evidence: src/wnn/multistage_search_runtime.py::run_owned_command; CONTRACT.json 180-second profile, 7200-second fit, six-hour campaign, 1200-second collection reserve.
risk_falsifier_table.status: Confirmed in current builder code; corrective patch requested, not yet re-reviewed.

risk_falsifier_table.topic: Owner receipt failure must not strand an unrecorded live process
risk_falsifier_table.risk: If writing a process ownership receipt fails after spawning a detached worker or profile child, the runner may propagate the I/O error while leaving a live process with no durable PID/birth/PGID record.
risk_falsifier_table.falsifier: Current launch_detached_worker and run_owned_command persist owner receipts after Popen without a cleanup guard around receipt-write failure.
risk_falsifier_table.smallest_resolution: On any post-spawn receipt failure, signal only the Popen-owned process group/handle, confirm exit, then propagate the error; retain root-owned exact PID/birth/PGID checks for normal cleanup.
risk_falsifier_table.status: Confirmed in current builder code; corrective patch requested, not yet re-reviewed.

risk_falsifier_table.topic: Exact profile and fit world-size identity conflict
risk_falsifier_table.risk: An exact config cannot be profiled at a world size different from the full fit identity, and the current admission/profile policy and candidate config request different values.
risk_falsifier_table.falsifier: Current validate_admission requires profile_policy.world_size == 1 while the current stage-one GRU/LSTM recipe config has required_world_size == 8.
risk_falsifier_table.smallest_resolution: Choose one per-recipe world-size policy with root after actual coexistence inventory; bind that same world size into profile policy, config, trial request, runtime identity and fit. Never profile a modified config.
risk_falsifier_table.status: Confirmed current code mismatch; root reports correction underway in a new R3 world-size-one recipe.

risk_falsifier_table.topic: Inner objective validator stamps an expected identity without verifying the producer identity
risk_falsifier_table.risk: A score receipt can be given the selected checkpoint identity hash even if its embedded producer provenance does not match that identity.
risk_falsifier_table.falsifier: Current validate_inner_objective receives expected_identity_sha256 but assigns it into the receipt without recomputing/comparing objective.producer.provenance.identity; select_best_control_epoch also trusts index entries without calling validate_index.
risk_falsifier_table.smallest_resolution: Validate the producer/checkpoint/split/fit-members and recompute canonical SHA256 of producer provenance identity before adding the identity hash; validate the epoch index schema/hash before selecting its checkpoint.
risk_falsifier_table.status: Confirmed in current builder code; corrective patch requested, not yet re-reviewed.

risk_falsifier_table.topic: Portable source mtime handling in index receipts
risk_falsifier_table.risk: A relocated byte-identical official parquet was rejected because the source-index verifier compared receiver mtime to the original root audit mtime.
risk_falsifier_table.falsifier: The reported receiver failure was in chronological_source_index._verify_source_audit_entry after full registry SHA validation; validator also compared receipt mtime to current file stat.
risk_falsifier_table.smallest_resolution: In registry mode verify the exact sealed full-file SHA/size first, ignore only current mtime, preserve the original audit mtime in index receipts, and retain strict local mode.
risk_falsifier_table.status: Patch reviewed statically: full hash/size validation precedes the mtime exception; source audit identity remains byte-bound; index receipt carries original audit mtime. Regression added but not run by critic; receiver rerun remains root-owned.

risk_falsifier_table.topic: Direct anchor-profile launcher UUID, config, receiver and timeout binding
risk_falsifier_table.risk: The original launcher selected GPUs 0-5 without UUID pinning, did not verify R3 config hashes or full receiver evidence, and could leave children running after launcher death.
risk_falsifier_table.falsifier: Static inspection of the original launch_anchor_profiles.py found index-only selection, free-memory-only preflight, incomplete receiver checks, no GNU timeout watchdog, and unbounded wait after kill.
risk_falsifier_table.smallest_resolution: Require the root B300 allowlist and receiver SHA/count receipt, compare each exact config to the R3 node hash, run by UUID with owned PID/birth/PGID receipts, and arm GNU timeout TERM/KILL watchdog under 180s.
risk_falsifier_table.status: Rewritten by critic and statically reviewed; py_compile passed. Six-profile launch remains root-owned and requires root materialize the strict inventory and receiver wrapper receipt; no GPU job was started by critic.
